passages.text: Our class is preparing a surprise thank-you book for the librarian who helps us every week. Mia asks everyone to keep a secret until all the pages are ready. Two groups work at the same time, with one writing messages while the other draws small pictures. Ben checks that each page has room for the writer's name without revealing the finished cover. When the pages are ready, the teacher puts them together and lets us choose a quiet moment to present them. Sharing the work helps the surprise feel like a gift from the whole class rather than one person.

parallelText.en: Our class is preparing a surprise thank-you book for the librarian who helps us every week.
parallelText.zh: 我们班在准备一本惊喜感谢册，送给每周帮助我们的图书管理员。

parallelText.en: Mia asks everyone to keep a secret until all the pages are ready.
parallelText.zh: 米娅请大家在所有书页准备好前保密。

parallelText.en: Two groups work at the same time, with one writing messages while the other draws small pictures.
parallelText.zh: 两个小组同时工作，一组写感谢语，另一组画小图。

parallelText.en: Ben checks that each page has room for the writer's name without revealing the finished cover.
parallelText.zh: 本检查每页是否留有写作者姓名的位置，不展示做好的封面。

parallelText.en: When the pages are ready, the teacher puts them together and lets us choose a quiet moment to present them.
parallelText.zh: 书页准备好后，老师装订，让我们选安静时刻赠送。

parallelText.en: Sharing the work helps the surprise feel like a gift from the whole class rather than one person.
parallelText.zh: 共同分工让这份惊喜成为全班的礼物，而不是一个人的礼物。

passages.text: Ben practises a short puppet show, but he feels sorry for Mia when her puppet's string breaks. She practises the same scene all week and worries that she cannot join the performance. Ben offers to give a helping hand by holding the spare puppet while she tests its movements. An adult repairs the broken string, and the two pupils compare which puppet is easier for the scene. Mia chooses the repaired one after a short trial and thanks Ben for staying beside her. The show begins only a little late, with both performers more confident because they solved the problem together.

parallelText.en: Ben practises a short puppet show, but he feels sorry for Mia when her puppet's string breaks.
parallelText.zh: 本在排练一出短木偶戏，但米娅的木偶线断了，他为她感到难过。

parallelText.en: She practises the same scene all week and worries that she cannot join the performance.
parallelText.zh: 她整个星期都在练习同一个场景，担心不能参加演出。

parallelText.en: Ben offers to give a helping hand by holding the spare puppet while she tests its movements.
parallelText.zh: 本提出帮忙，握着备用木偶，让她测试动作。

parallelText.en: An adult repairs the broken string, and the two pupils compare which puppet is easier for the scene.
parallelText.zh: 成人修好断线，两位同学比较哪个木偶更适合这场戏。

parallelText.en: Mia chooses the repaired one after a short trial and thanks Ben for staying beside her.
parallelText.zh: 短暂试用后，米娅选择修好的木偶，感谢本一直陪伴。

parallelText.en: The show begins only a little late, with both performers more confident because they solved the problem together.
parallelText.zh: 演出只晚了一会儿，两位演员因共同解决问题而更自信。
